title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
We are looking for a driven Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our people team in London and own full-cycle recruitment across a fast-growing professional services group.

Your mission: You will partner with hiring managers to attract, assess and hire great people, delivering a smooth candidate experience while keeping our applicant tracking system clean and reliable.

What you will do:
- Manage end-to-end recruitment for corporate and support functions, from intake to offer
- Source active and passive candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals and job boards
- Screen applications, run structured interviews and coordinate assessment stages
- Maintain accurate pipelines and reporting inside our ATS and HRIS (Workday)
- Advise managers on job descriptions, market trends and inclusive hiring practices

About you:
- At least 3 years of experience in in-house or agency recruitment
- Confident using an ATS/HRIS and sourcing tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- A structured, data-aware approach to pipeline and candidate management

Nice to have: Experience with Workday recruiting and employer branding campaigns.

Work policy: Hybrid with an office in London and up to three days remote per week. We offer a collaborative people team, modern tooling and genuine scope to shape how we hire.

title: Office Manager
description:
A growing technology company in Dublin is looking for a proactive Office Manager to keep our workplace running smoothly and to be the friendly point of contact for the whole team.

Your mission: You will own day-to-day office operations, create a welcoming environment and support leadership with reliable administrative coordination.

What you will do:
- Manage office facilities, suppliers, deliveries and health-and-safety basics
- Coordinate meetings, travel and events, and support onboarding of new joiners
- Handle purchase orders, invoices and expense tracking with the finance team
- Maintain accurate records and documents across MS Office and shared drives
- Support internal communications and act as the go-to person for office queries

About you:
- At least 2 years of experience in office management, administration or a similar role
- Strong organisation skills and confident use of MS Office, especially Excel and Outlook
- A warm, service-minded approach and the ability to juggle competing priorities
- Good written and spoken English and comfort working with external suppliers

Nice to have: Experience with basic bookkeeping tools and event coordination.

Work policy: Onsite with a modern office in Dublin and occasional flexibility. We offer a friendly, fast-moving team and real ownership of how our workplace feels.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Our SaaS business in New York is looking for an empathetic Customer Success Manager to own a portfolio of accounts and help our customers get real value from our platform.

Your mission: You will be the trusted advisor for your customers, driving adoption, retention and growth while acting as their voice inside the company.

What you will do:
- Own onboarding, adoption and renewal for a portfolio of mid-market accounts
- Build success plans, run business reviews and track customer health metrics
- Partner with support, product and sales to resolve issues and surface opportunities
- Manage customer conversations and tickets through Zendesk and Intercom
- Identify expansion opportunities and reduce churn through proactive outreach

About you:
- At least 4 years of experience in customer success, account management or support
- Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills
- Comfortable using CRM and support tools such as Zendesk and Intercom
- A data-informed approach to adoption, retention and customer health

Nice to have: Experience in a B2B SaaS environment and familiarity with Salesforce.

Work policy: Hybrid with an office in New York and flexible remote days. We offer a customer-obsessed culture, clear growth paths and direct impact on retention.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
A shared-service centre in Manchester is looking for an organised Project Coordinator to support delivery teams and keep cross-functional projects on track.

Your mission: You will be the connective tissue of our project teams, coordinating tasks, timelines and stakeholders so that work is delivered on time and to plan.

What you will do:
- Coordinate project plans, timelines and resources across delivery teams
- Track tasks, risks and actions in Jira and Asana and keep boards up to date
- Prepare status reports, meeting notes and follow-ups for stakeholders
- Support project managers with scheduling, documentation and reporting
- Help apply lightweight PRINCE2-aligned governance and standards

About you:
- At least 2 years of experience in project coordination, PMO or operations support
- Confident using project tools such as Jira and Asana and strong MS Office skills
- Excellent organisation, attention to detail and stakeholder communication
- A proactive, dependable approach to chasing actions and hitting deadlines

Nice to have: PRINCE2 Foundation certification and experience in a shared-service or professional services environment.

Work policy: Hybrid with an office in Manchester and up to two days remote per week. We offer varied projects, supportive teams and a clear path towards project management.

title: HR Business Partner
description:
A non-profit organisation with a national footprint, based in Bristol, is looking for a seasoned HR Business Partner to advise leaders and drive our people agenda.

Your mission: You will be a trusted partner to senior stakeholders, aligning people strategy with organisational goals and coaching managers through the full employee lifecycle.

What you will do:
- Partner with leadership on workforce planning, talent and organisational design
- Advise managers on employee relations, performance and change management
- Lead people initiatives across engagement, retention and development
- Use HRIS data (Workday, SuccessFactors) to inform decisions and reporting
- Ensure people practices are fair, compliant and aligned with our values

About you:
- At least 7 years of HR experience, including several as an HR Business Partner
- Strong knowledge of employee relations and UK employment practices
- Confident using an HRIS such as Workday or SuccessFactors
- Excellent stakeholder management, coaching and influencing skills

Nice to have: CIPD qualification and experience in the non-profit or public sector.

Work policy: Hybrid with an office in Bristol and up to three days remote per week. We offer a meaningful mission, senior visibility and scope to shape our people strategy.
